failure_summary.description: Agents failed to apply and save the newly stated restaurant neighborhood or budget constraint to the relevant cached results.
Agents mishandled stated return dates as outbound criteria and failed to complete all requested travel domains.
An agent imported unavailable tools and printed a no-planning message after already performing planning actions.

patch.reasoning: Add short pre-emission checks for complete per-domain updates and flight-leg mapping, clarify how round-trip dates support a requested hotel stay, and reinforce the direct-tool execution contract. These target recurring omissions without changing existing schemas or duplicating broad tool guidance.

edits.content: Before writing calls, make a per-domain checklist from the full conversation of requested actions and every newly stated criterion, including a reply to an assistant question. For a valid cached base, retrieve it into a local variable, pass every new criterion as a supported filter argument, and save the refined result under a new key. A filter call with only `prior_results`, or a fresh search that merely repeats criteria already represented in cache, does not apply the update.

Before finalizing flight calls, verify that each stated outbound and return segment has its own route/date pair, with the return route reversed and its date used as that leg’s `departure_date`. Do not encode a return date as an alternative outbound date or an `arrival_date`, and do not pass parameters absent from the flight tool schema.

edits.target: - For multi-city trips, preserve the stated destination sequence and match each date to its corresponding leg. Do not combine dates or invent arrival dates.
edits.content: - If the user also requests a hotel for the same round trip and gives no separate lodging dates, use the outbound date as hotel check-in and the return date as check-out, in the trip destination city; do not omit the hotel search just because the latest turn discussed flights.

## Execute tools directly
- Call the provided tool functions directly; do not import tools, alter module paths, or redefine tools or their models. Use `print("No planning needed")` only instead of planning calls when valid cache results already satisfy the entire request—never append it after performing searches, filters, sorts, or nearest-results calls.
